ca_guntower_wall.blurb: Guntower Wall is a slab crag in the Meyers area, a short way from South Lake Tahoe. It holds eleven routes, nearly all bolted sport lines with a single trad route, running from 5.8 into the low 5.12s, with the bulk between 5.9 and 5.11. The slabs are well protected, which makes it a decent place to step up in grade without much fear. The wall is more interesting and more difficult than the neighboring Cal Trans Wall. Because the sun swings behind the crag, summer is best at the start or end of the day. A very short trail off the main bike trail gets you there with no real uphill hiking.

ca_goat_rock_3.blurb: Goat Rock sits among the High Peaks South formations in Pinnacles National Park on the Central Coast. Nearly all the climbing is on its east face, with eleven routes that are mostly trad and a couple of bolted lines, from an easy 5.3 up to the 5.10 range. Expect a mix of long thin streaks, a few reaching about 180 feet in one pitch, and deeper chimneys. The volcanic rock is better than most at Pinnacles but sees little traffic, so test holds before trusting them. It is quiet and best suited to climbers already comfortable with Pinnacles rock. Every route finishes with a walk-off.
ca_goat_rock_3.approach: About 45 minutes on foot. Most parties go by the western side around Satyr Pinnacle; some routes are reached through the gap between Satyr Pinnacle and Goat Rock, others by dropping northwest toward the northeast end of the rock.

ca_nap_wall_area.blurb: Nap Wall Area is a section of Slick Rock Dome, a low-angle dome off the Highway 50 corridor not far from Lover's Leap. It has eleven routes, mostly trad with a few sport lines and top-rope options, ranging from about 5.5 to 5.10, with plenty in the 5.6 to 5.9 range. Expect clean faces and slabs, with several two-pitch lines. The dome has little shade, so mornings are kinder in summer. Reach the wall by following the trail a few minutes beyond the Crystal Wall area. Getting down is straightforward: walk off the top along the dome's edge, with some class 4 ground at first.
